name: BirFatura Invoicing
description: Publishes this shop's paid orders for BirFatura to pull and invoice. The integrator calls in with a shared secret; nothing is sent out.
author: Blysis

settingsCards.title: BirFatura Invoicing
settingsCards.description: The secret BirFatura signs in with to collect your orders.

api.description: The states an order can be in, so the integrator can pick the one to invoice.
How this shop takes money, read from the orders themselves.
The paid orders in a window, with their lines, for the integrator that pulls them.
The invoice the integrator issued for an order: its link, number and date.

birfaturaInvoicing.adm_subtitle: This service collects your orders rather than being sent them. Give it a secret here and the same one in its own store settings.
birfaturaInvoicing.adm_tokenDesc: A long random string of your own choosing. It is the only thing guarding your customers' addresses and tax numbers, so treat it as a password. Blank means nobody gets in.

admin.module_birfatura-invoicing_description: Sends this shop's paid orders to BirFatura, which raises the invoice
admin.settings_birfatura-invoicing_description: The secret BirFatura signs in with to collect your orders.

birfaturaInvoicing.adm_subtitle: Bu servis siparişleri kendisi toplar, biz göndermeyiz. Buraya bir gizli anahtar yazın ve aynısını onun mağaza ayarlarına girin.
birfaturaInvoicing.adm_tokenDesc: Kendi seçeceğiniz uzun ve rastgele bir dizi. Müşterilerinizin adreslerini ve vergi numaralarını koruyan tek şey bu, parola gibi saklayın. Boş bırakılırsa kimse giremez.

admin.module_birfatura-invoicing_description: Bu mağazanın ödenmiş siparişlerini faturayı kesen BirFatura'ya gönderir
admin.settings_birfatura-invoicing_description: BirFatura'nın siparişlerinizi almak için imzaladığı gizli anahtar.
